title: Because of robes, bhikkhus, craving arises for a bhikkhu. Because of almsfood, bhikkhus, craving arises for a bhikkhu. Because of lodgings, bhikkhus, craving arises for…
content:
Because of robes, bhikkhus, craving arises for a bhikkhu. Because of almsfood, bhikkhus, craving arises for a bhikkhu. Because of lodgings, bhikkhus, craving arises for a bhikkhu. Because of this or that kind of existence, bhikkhus, craving arises for a bhikkhu. These are the four kinds of arising of craving from which craving arises for a bhikkhu.

One with craving as companion
Wanders for a long time.
He does not transcend the round of existence,
From this life to the next.

Knowing this danger,
That craving gives birth to suffering,
Free from craving, without clinging,
Mindful, the bhikkhu wanders.

title: Bhikkhus, in the future, bhikkhus will desire delicious almsfood. Because they desire delicious almsfood, they will abandon the almsfood round, abandon the forests, the remote…
content: Bhikkhus, in the future, bhikkhus will desire delicious almsfood. Because they desire delicious almsfood, they will abandon the almsfood round, abandon the forests, the remote highland dwellings, and go to villages, towns, and royal cities, dwelling there, seeking exquisite flavors with their tongues. Because of almsfood, they will fall into improper, unsuitable seeking. This, bhikkhus, is the second fear regarding the future, not yet arisen now but will arise in the future. You should fully understand them. Having fully understood them, you should strive to abandon that fear.

title: - Friend Sāriputta, what things should a virtuous bhikkhu attend to wisely? - Friend Kotthika, a virtuous bhikkhu should attend wisely to the five aggregates…
content: - Friend Sāriputta, what things should a virtuous bhikkhu attend to wisely? - Friend Kotthika, a virtuous bhikkhu should attend wisely to the five aggregates of clinging as impermanent, suffering, a disease, a boil, a dart, a calamity, an affliction, alien, breaking up, empty, and non-self. What are the five? That is, the form aggregate of clinging, the feeling aggregate of clinging, the perception aggregate of clinging, the formation aggregate of clinging, the consciousness aggregate of clinging. Friend Kotthika, a virtuous bhikkhu should attend wisely to the five aggregates of clinging as impermanent, suffering, a disease, a boil, a dart, a calamity, an affliction, alien, breaking up, empty, and non-self.

title: One who among all beings Understands liberation From the trap of death, For the happiness of devas and humans, Declares the noble truth, Declares the…
content:
One who among all beings
Understands liberation
From the trap of death,
For the happiness of devas and humans,
Declares the noble truth,
Declares the true Dhamma.
The multitude seeing and hearing this
Rejoice with serene faith.
Skilled in the path and non-path,
What should be done has been done,
Taintless, Enlightened,
With this last body,
He is called by name,
Great Wisdom, Great Man.

title: Just as, bhikkhus, a person were to take the grass, sticks, branches, and leaves of this Jeta's Grove, and burn them or use them as…
content: Just as, bhikkhus, a person were to take the grass, sticks, branches, and leaves of this Jeta's Grove, and burn them or use them as he wishes. Would you think: 'That person takes us, burns us, or uses us as he wishes'?" — "No, Venerable Sir. Why is that? Because that is not us. Venerable Sir, that is not our self." — "So too, bhikkhus, form is not yours, abandon it. Abandoning it will lead to your long-term welfare and happiness. Feeling is not yours ... Perception is not yours ... Formations are not yours ... Consciousness is not yours, abandon it. Abandoning it will lead to your long-term welfare and happiness.

title: Just as, bhikkhus, in a king's frontier fortress there is a moat, both deep and wide, to protect those inside the fortress and to keep…
content: Just as, bhikkhus, in a king's frontier fortress there is a moat, both deep and wide, to protect those inside the fortress and to keep out those outside. So too, bhikkhus, a noble disciple has moral shame. He is ashamed of evil bodily action, evil verbal action, evil mental action. He is ashamed of falling into evil, unwholesome states. Using moral shame as the moat, bhikkhus, the noble disciple abandons the unwholesome, develops the wholesome, abandons what is blameworthy, develops what is blameless, and keeps himself pure. With this second excellent quality he is accomplished.

title: Elder Vacchapāla: If one sees the truth, wonderful, subtle, With wisdom skillfully, with humble mind, Living according to the virtue prescribed by the Buddha, Nibbāna…
content:
Elder Vacchapāla:

If one sees the truth, wonderful, subtle,
With wisdom skillfully, with humble mind,
Living according to the virtue prescribed by the Buddha,
Nibbāna is not hard to attain for that one.

title: There are these four times. What four? Hearing the Dhamma at the right time, discussing the Dhamma at the right time, calming at the right…
content: There are these four times. What four? Hearing the Dhamma at the right time, discussing the Dhamma at the right time, calming at the right time, contemplating at the right time. These, bhikkhus, are the four times.

title: At that time, on the Uposatha day, the fifteenth, the full moon night of the Komudi festival in the fourth month, the Blessed One was…
content: At that time, on the Uposatha day, the fifteenth, the full moon night of the Komudi festival in the fourth month, the Blessed One was seated in the open air, surrounded by the assembly of bhikkhus. Then the Blessed One, after surveying the silent, utterly silent assembly of bhikkhus, addressed them: 'This assembly, bhikkhus, has no idle talk. This assembly, bhikkhus, has no superfluous talk; it is established in the pure heartwood. Such a community of bhikkhus, bhikkhus, such an assembly, bhikkhus, is worthy of veneration, worthy of respect, worthy of offerings, worthy of reverential salutation, the unsurpassed field of merit for the world. Such a community of bhikkhus, bhikkhus, such an assembly, bhikkhus, is an assembly where a small offering yields great fruit, and a great offering yields even greater fruit. Such a community of bhikkhus, bhikkhus, such an assembly, bhikkhus, is hard to see in the world. Such a community of bhikkhus, bhikkhus, such an assembly, bhikkhus, is worthy of being traveled to for many leagues with a provisions-bag on one's shoulder in order to see it.'

title: In whatever direction, bhikkhus, bhikkhus live in rivalry, disputation, conflict, wounding one another with verbal weapons, that direction is not comfortable for me, bhikkhus, to…
content: In whatever direction, bhikkhus, bhikkhus live in rivalry, disputation, conflict, wounding one another with verbal weapons, that direction is not comfortable for me, bhikkhus, to think of, let alone to go there. Therein, I come to this conclusion: 'Surely, those bhikkhus have abandoned three things and cultivated three things too much.' What three have they abandoned? Thoughts of renunciation, thoughts of non-ill-will, thoughts of non-harming. These three they have abandoned. What three have they cultivated too much? Thoughts of sensual desire, thoughts of ill-will, thoughts of harming. These three they have cultivated too much.
